name: 6lets
description: 6Lets - a daily six-letter word puzzle (Cloudflare Pages + D1)

scripts.//test: --experimental-sqlite is required on Node 22.x, where node:sqlite exists but is flagged, and is a harmless no-op from 23.4 where it was unflagged. Without it the database-backed tests skip themselves and the suite exits 0 having verified nothing; test/database.test.mjs fails loudly if that happens.
scripts.//test-glob: The pattern is QUOTED and explicit, not a bare `test/`. Since Node 22.6 the test runner reads positional arguments as glob patterns, so `test/` resolves to one file that does not exist and dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before running anything. Quoting stops the shell expanding it first, so Node does the globbing. Naming *.test.mjs also keeps test/helpers/*.mjs out of the run — Node's default discovery treats every file under a test/ directory as a test file, which would load the helpers as empty suites.
scripts.//deploy:safe: Migrations before the deploy, chained with && — new code selects columns that do not exist yet, so a deploy that outruns its schema 500s on every affected route while the static pages render perfectly. The reverse order is safe.
scripts.deploy:safe: npm run db:migrate && wrangler pages deploy
